MapGroupClusterFile places cluster prototypes at world positions and can include
additional cluster placement files.

## MapGroupInstance

MapGroupInstance places one prototype at a concrete map location in a map group
file.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 4 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### MapGroupInstance.a

Key: `a`

Path: [`group`](#mapgroupclusterfilegroup).`[]`.`a`

A is the instance's heading angle in degrees when the placement uses a single
yaw value.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `1.999835` |

### MapGroupInstance.name

Key: `name`

Path: [`group`](#mapgroupclusterfilegroup).`[]`.`name`

Name is the prototype or group identifier resolved by CE.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `PearTree2` |

### MapGroupInstance.pos

Key: `pos`

Path: [`group`](#mapgroupclusterfilegroup).`[]`.`pos`

Pos is the instance's world position as an X/Y/Z vector.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `40.327084 10.632996 1613.091797` |

### MapGroupInstance.rpy

Key: `rpy`

Path: [`group`](#mapgroupclusterfilegroup).`[]`.`rpy`

RPY is the instance's roll, pitch, and yaw rotation when the placement uses all
three angles.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `-0.000000 0.000000 -70.013718` |
